content:

title: Transaera tests its heat pump with metal-organic framework dehumidification in apartment building
content:
U.S. startup Transaera will test its all-electric rooftop heat pump system in a multifamily residential building in Washington, D.C., with support from a $125,000 grant. The technology uses metal–organic frameworks for dehumidification and reportedly cuts energy consumption by around 40% compared with conventional rooftop HVAC units.

title: Hemispherical perovskite solar cell design reduces sensitivity to sunlight angle
content:
Chinese researchers have designed a hemispherical perovskite solar cell with a textured surface to improve light absorption and reduce sensitivity to sunlight incidence angles. Simulations showed absorption exceeding 95% and an average maximum power output of 28.25 mW/cm² across incidence angles of 0° to 50°.

content:

title: Residential solar prices rise 3.2% as third-party ownership gains ground
content: Residential solar prices climbed 3.2% in the first half of 2026 as installers adjusted to the expiration of the federal residential solar tax credit. EnergySage's latest marketplace report highlights a surge in third-party ownership financing, rising installation costs, and shifting equipment market shares as the industry navigates a changing economic landscape.
